lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCu₃(NiO₄)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/a (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms—Li₄Cu₁₂Ni₈O₃₂—distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Li centers coordinated by four O neighbors, tetrahedral Ni centers also coordinated by four O neighbors, and octahedral Cu centers coordinated by six O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Li and Ni tetrahedra, as well as between Ni tetrahedra and Cu octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
